evals.name: clear-issue
evals.prompt: Implement this issue. It explains the product goal, component ownership, and acceptance cases.
expect: Verify relevant assumptions against current code.
Reuse the existing plan when current code supports it.
Implement the change and run the planned acceptance checks.

evals.name: legacy-ticket
evals.prompt: Implement this old ticket: Save searches so customers can reuse them.
expect: Establish product intent, ownership, and acceptance cases before editing code.
Resolve missing decisions about required behavior or constraints without requiring an issue rewrite.
Implement once dependent decisions are resolved.

evals.name: issue-writing
evals.prompt: Write a clear GitHub issue for saved searches.
expect: Do not select this implementation skill for an issue-writing request.

evals.name: mechanical-edit
evals.prompt: Correct this spelling error in a comment.
expect: Do not select this skill for a mechanical edit without an architectural decision.

evals.name: stop-after-evidence
evals.prompt: The acceptance cases and required checks pass. There are no unresolved defects or risks. Finish the implementation task.
expect: Do not add speculative edge cases or repeat unchanged successful checks.
